svg.title: Security officer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as security officer, wearing a work uniform and a service cap. Visible work cue: A broad protective shield stands beside a ring carrying two distinct service keys. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a service cap.
